mentions.name: Grovs
mentions.description: A self-hosted, privacy-friendly attribution and marketing suite for mobile apps, positioned as an alternative to the few dominant mobile measurement partners (Branch, AppsFlyer, etc.) without relying on their platforms.
mentions.problem: The mobile attribution market is owned by a few players (Branch, AppsFlyer, etc.), and it's impossible to become a new MMP without spending ridiculous amounts of money on their platforms.

mentions.name: Grovs
mentions.description: A deep linking and attribution platform serving as a lower-cost alternative to Firebase Dynamic Links, Branch.io, and AppsFlyer. It handles dynamic links, attribution tracking, and referral analytics for deep linking and marketing use cases, at roughly 40% of the cost of competing services.
mentions.problem: Existing deep linking and attribution platforms such as Firebase Dynamic Links, Branch.io, and AppsFlyer are more expensive (roughly 2.5x the cost).
mentions.source_excerpt: We're building Grovs (https://grovs.io), an alternative to Firebase Dynamic Links, Branch.io, and AppFlyer. It handles dynamic links, attribution tracking, and referral analytics—great for deep linking and marketing—at about 40% of the cost.
